training.augmentation: per-image square resized crop area [0.6,1.0], bilinear, horizontal flip p=0.5; no mixup
training.schedule: linear warmup 5 epochs, cosine decay to 1% base LR; per optimizer step

muon_aux_adamw.matrix_rule: name starts with blocks. and parameter.ndim == 2

decay_rule: Use the stated weight decay on tensors with ndim >= 2; zero decay on vectors/scalars. In the Muon run, hidden matrices use Muon decay; auxiliary parameters follow the same ndim rule.
checkpoint_selection: highest validation top-1 accuracy, keep earliest epoch on ties
split: 450 train + 50 validation images per class from official train; official labeled validation is final held-out test; official unlabeled test unused
